title: Closed nonlinear Gauss constraint and positive longitudinal reduction

constraint.phase_topology: E in L2; pi in L2; phi in the K1372 covariant charge-Sobolev topology
constraint.continuity: div is bounded L2 to H^-1 and the nonlinear density is continuous by K1372
constraint.closed_zero_set: G^-1(0) is closed in the covariant phase topology

elliptic_reduction.right_inverse: R rho=-grad(-Delta)^-1 rho, with div R rho=rho
elliptic_reduction.bound: ||R rho||_L2 <= ||rho||_H^-1 under the Fourier H^-1_0 norm
elliptic_reduction.decomposition: E=E_T+R rho, div E_T=0, and <E_T,R rho>_L2=0
